taste:
The Pepperoni Pizza is rich and savoury, with a little spice rather than a topping described as intensely hot. Sliced pepperoni supplies the smoky flavour, while its crisp edges contrast with the thick layer of melting mozzarella. Rich tomato sauce sits underneath, bringing the meat and cheese together on a thin, crispy base.

Served fresh and hot, it has a clear contrast between the creamy cheese and the crisper base and pepperoni. The oils released by the meat during baking add richness throughout the topping. This suits someone who enjoys a generous meat topping and a thin base, rather than looking for a pizza led by vegetables.
